title: Why Your Turn Signal Blinks Twice As Fast
hook: Never ignore a fast-blinking turn signal.

script.narration: Never ignore a fast-blinking turn signal.
script.visual_search: car dashboard turn signal blinking fast at night

script.narration: If your blinker suddenly clicks twice as fast, it is not a random glitch. Your car is actually alerting you that a front or rear turn signal bulb has burned out.
script.visual_search: car headlight and blinker close up in traffic

script.narration: When a bulb dies, the system detects lower electrical load and speeds up the flash. Driving with a dead blinker hides your turns from other drivers.

description:
Did you know a fast-blinking turn signal is actually a built-in warning system? Many drivers think rapid clicking on the dashboard is just a minor electrical glitch, but it is your car telling you a bulb is out.

Learn this simple driving tip in under 60 seconds so you can fix dead bulbs quickly, avoid traffic tickets, and keep other drivers safe on the road.
why_it_will_work: Auto repair and common car mysteries are trending, and this answers a super relatable driving question that appeals to both new and experienced drivers.
